name: post_payment_intents_intent_confirm
description: Confirm that your customer intends to pay with current or provided payment method; upon confirmation the PaymentIntent transitions to requires_capture (manual capture_method) or succeeded. (POST /v1/payment_intents/{intent}/confirm)

intent.description: The identifier of the PaymentIntent to confirm.

payment_method.description: ID of the payment method (a PaymentMethod, Card, or compatible Source object) to attach to this PaymentIntent.
